name: fly-me-to-the-moon
title: Fly Me To The Moon (In Other Words)
formNote: Sinatra/Basie 1964, in C like the chart. 4-bar intro; chorus 1 from 0:08.5 and chorus 2 from 1:12.6. Basie reharmonises the last 4 bars of each chorus and adds the A♭7-B♭7 ending, so only chart bars 1-28 of each chorus are scored.
